name: us3-feature-no-plan-context
description: T085 — the normal before_specify state: SPEC_KIT_JIRA_PLAN_CONTEXT is empty (plan context only exists after /plan). The guarded create cannot resolve a story type id, so the ceremony MUST take the FR-016 fallback ({active:false} + one warning, exit 0) with zero Jira calls — not die on an invalid default.
